facts.evidenceNote: Official university identity from the separately dated university review.

The current faculty doctorate overview and its linked official notice identify the Dr.-Ing. research award. Acceptance and FAQ rules establish individually supervised independent dissertation research in faculty fields and an oral examination. The faculty institute inventory explicitly includes IFAB, whose official name is Institute of Human and Industrial Engineering and whose own staff opportunities page lists doctoral study. The qualifying title is the actual academic institute host, not the generic Mechanical Engineering parent or a newly invented Industrial Engineering degree/specialization.
